svg.title: PCB Refurbishment Workflow — Electrolyte Solutions
svg.desc: End-to-end process flow from PCB receipt to dispatch, with role-based steps and validation gates

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the GRN receiving step for PCB refurbishment')
g.text: Team lead logs: lot, qty sent vs received

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should inventory counting and logging work for PCBs?')
g.text: Count, assign lot IDs, enter in system

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does PCB segregation into repairable vs non-repairable work?')
sendPrompt('What are the steps in the PCB repair process?')
g.text: Employee logs: defect type, action taken

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What testing happens after PCB repair?')

g.text: Return to repair, log debug steps

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What data gets logged after a PCB is repaired and tested?')
g.text: PCB name, lot, qty sent vs returned

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens at the QC and dispatch stage for repaired PCBs?')
sendPrompt('How should the top 3 employee reward system work monthly?')
